entities.name: Cholestanol
observations: Cholestanol (5alpha-cholestan-3beta-ol; dihydrocholesterol) at 10 microg/mL induced apoptosis-associated changes in cultured corneal endothelial and lens epithelial cells in vitro.
The study used cholesterol and ethanol vehicle comparators; the apoptotic effect was attributed specifically to cholestanol under the tested conditions.

entities.name: Corneal endothelial cells
observations: In a primary in-vitro study, cholestanol exposure reduced viability, increased TUNEL-positive nuclei and apoptotic DNA fragmentation, and increased ICE and CPP32/caspase-3-like activity.

entities.name: Lens epithelial cells
observations: In a primary in-vitro study, cholestanol exposure reduced viability, increased TUNEL-positive nuclei and apoptotic DNA fragmentation, and increased ICE and CPP32/caspase-3-like activity.

entities.name: PMID:10752932
observations: Primary IOVS 2000 study titled Cholestanol induces apoptosis of corneal endothelial and lens epithelial cells.
Cultured cells were exposed to 10 microg/mL cholestanol; apoptosis was assessed by viability, TUNEL/laser cytometry, DNA fragmentation, and ICE/CPP32 activity.
